blocks.text: Thank you for the call this morning. To confirm in writing what we agreed, including Julie's request:

1. You will send the investor presentation together with the recurring questions from recent investor meetings. A rough list is fine.
2. You will book the remaining leadership interviews and send me the times.
3. The findings memo goes to you alone first, and you will decide who else at {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} sees it.
I will hold the findings memo until the investor questions are in, so that it reflects them. When your interview times arrive, I will confirm each one in writing the same day.
